in_marathi.name: Arya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Arya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Arya is a Sanskrit name that means 'noble', 'honorable', 'pure', or 'aristocrat'. In Hindu mythology, Arya is a term used to describe a member of the noble or learned class. This name is often given to girls to signify purity and nobility.
